purpose: Typed semantic relationships for the solver premise-space atlas. The v1 graph's untyped pairs remain ancestry seed data; this file records decision-bearing relation meaning and may grow independently.

relationTypes.SEMANTIC_PARENT: source is the broader question; target is a narrower descendant
relationTypes.TESTED_FORM_OF: source is a concrete tested formulation of target
relationTypes.SUPPORTS: source supplies evidence that raises confidence in target without proving it
relationTypes.FALSIFIES_SCOPE: source closes target only in an explicitly stated scope
relationTypes.NARROWS: source removes one formulation while leaving the broader target open
relationTypes.PREREQUISITE: source must be established before target can be interpreted or acted on
relationTypes.ENABLES: a positive source creates a meaningful downstream target question
relationTypes.CONSUMES: source uses a fact/capability represented by target
relationTypes.SUBSTITUTES_FOR: source can supply similar capability through a materially different operation
relationTypes.COMPLEMENTS: source and target can supply conjunctive capability
relationTypes.CAUSAL_PREDECESSOR: source is an earlier loss whose failure blocks relevance of target
relationTypes.OBSERVES: source is principally a diagnostic/probe for target
relationTypes.CONSTRAINS: source bounds safe/economic/valid implementations of target
relationTypes.REOPENS_ON: source is a changed condition that makes target live again
relationTypes.SUPERSEDES: source replaces an older target interpretation
relationTypes.EVIDENCE_DEPENDS_ON: the verdict on source depends on target being valid/established
